items.name: use-active-anchor

items.name: use-clock
items.title: Use Clock

items.name: use-coerce-to-motion-value
items.title: Use Coerce To Motion Value

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: Use Copy To Clipboard
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard and reports its state.

items.name: use-event-listener
items.title: Use Event Listener

items.name: use-interval
items.title: Use Interval
items.description: Runs a callback repeatedly at a configurable interval.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: Use Media Query
items.description: Subscribes to a responsive CSS media query.

items.name: use-mouse-position
items.title: Use Mouse Position
items.description: Exposes the pointer position as Motion values.

items.name: use-normalize-motion-value
items.title: Use Normalize Motion Value
items.description: Normalizes a Motion value into a bounded range.

items.name: use-resize-observer
items.title: Use Resize Observer
items.description: Observes and reports an element's dimensions.
